key_points: Multiple analyst price target hikes (Baird to $1,520, super bull $2,000) suggest elevated expectations ahead of Q4 earnings
Negative AI-related news over weekend pressured shares but may be priced in
Citi raised estimates, indicating improving fundamental outlook
Earnings reaction will likely dominate near-term price action; headlines themselves are mostly noise
Extreme price targets ($1,520-$2,000) appear unrealistic vs. current ~$100-150 range, signaling possible hyperbolic commentary
